Category.description: Type of threat indicator or breach activity identified by the alert

Severity.description: Indicates the potential impact (high, medium, or low) of the threat indicator or breach activity identified by the alert

ServiceSource.description: Product or service that provided the alert information

DetectionSource.description: Detection technology or sensor that identified the notable component or activity

AttackTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques associated with the activity that triggered the alert

Timestamp.description: Date and time when the event was recorded

Categories.description: List of categories that the information belongs to, in JSON array format

AttackTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques associated with the activity that triggered the alert

ServiceSource.description: Product or service that provided the alert information

DetectionSource.description: Detection technology or sensor that identified the notable component or activity

EntityType.description: Type of object, such as a file, a process, a device, or a user

EvidenceRole.description: How the entity is involved in an alert, indicating whether it is impacted or is merely related

EvidenceDirection.description: Indicates whether the entity is the source or the destination of a network connection

FileName.description: Name of the file that the recorded action was applied to

FolderPath.description: Folder containing the file that the recorded action was applied to

SHA1.description: SHA-1 of the file that the recorded action was applied to

SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the file that the recorded action was applied to. This field is usually not populated—use the SHA1 column when available.

FileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes

ThreatFamily.description: Malware family that the suspicious or malicious file or process has been classified under

RemoteIP.description: IP address that was being connected to

RemoteUrl.description: URL or fully qualified domain name (FQDN) that was being connected to

AccountObjectId.description: Unique identifier for the account in Microsoft Entra ID

AccountUpn.description: User principal name (UPN) of the account

DeviceId.description: Unique identifier for the device in the service

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the device

LocalIP.description: IP address assigned to the local device used during communication

NetworkMessageId.description: Unique identifier for the email, generated by Office 365

Application.description: Application that performed the recorded action

OAuthApplicationId.description: Unique identifier of the third-party OAuth application

ProcessCommandLine.description: Command line used to create the new process

RegistryKey.description: Registry key that the recorded action was applied to

RegistryValueName.description: Name of the registry value that the recorded action was applied to

RegistryValueData.description: Data of the registry value that the recorded action was applied to

AdditionalFields.description: Additional information about the entity or event

Severity.description: Indicates the potential impact (high, medium, or low) of the threat indicator or breach activity identified by the alert

CloudPlatform.description: The cloud platform that the resource belongs to, can be Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform

ResourceID.description: Unique identifier of the cloud resource accessed

SubscriptionId.description: Unique identifier of the cloud service subscription
